locations.name: El Far Restaurant (Sant Sebastià)
locations.description: The restaurant of Hotel El Far, terrace beside the Sant Sebastià lighthouse ~175 m above the sea — Mediterranean rice dishes, Palamós fish and shellfish, local produce; classic scenic cooking without avant-garde technique. Trip-week schedule: dinner Monday and Wednesday; closed Tuesdays from Sep 8. Take a taxi up (🚗 8 min), not the steep walk after wine.
locations.address: Carrer de l'Uruguai, 87, 17211 Llafranc, Girona, Spain

references.note: Rank 8: dramatic elevated view, classic Mediterranean menu; open Mon Sep 7 and Wed Sep 9, closed Tue; taxi not walk after wine.
Official restaurant page and schedule.

locations.name: Far Nomo
locations.description: Japanese-Mediterranean from Grupo Nomo in the lighthouse/cliff setting above Llafranc — sushi, gyoza, miso eggplant, tuna/salmon/red-mullet raw plates, tempura, grilled octopus, chicken kara-age and vegetarian rolls, with cocktails and the drop-away view. The change-of-pace dinner after several Mediterranean nights; books via Resy. Chelsea-rich menu (skip the foie/duck and meat plates).
locations.address: Passeig de Pau Casals, 64, 17211 Llafranc, Girona, Spain

references.note: Rank 9: best non-Catalan change of pace — abundant Chelsea options (gyoza, raw fish, tempura, veggie rolls); verify dates on Resy.
Official restaurant page.

locations.name: Sa Jambina
locations.description: Michelin-selected, fish-first cooking now relocated to Palafrugell town — market fish, Mediterranean shellfish, red-prawn tartare and whole baked fish, elegant but unshowy. Per the dinner-plan note, the strongest pure culinary option of the leg after Casamar; no sea view, 9 minutes by car from Mas Pastora. Trip-week calendar showed Wednesday Sep 9 bookable at 8:30–10:00 PM; Tuesday not reservable online; Monday by phone.
locations.address: Carrer de Picasso, 37, 17200 Palafrugell, Girona, Spain

references.note: Rank 10 but 'strongest pure culinary option after Casamar': Wed Sep 9 live at 20:30/21:00/21:30/22:00; Tue not bookable online; Mon call.
Official restaurant page; reservations via myrestoo.

locations.name: Terrassa Terramar
locations.description: The beachfront terrace of Hotel Terramar on Llafranc's promenade — Mediterranean/Empordà cooking with direct bay views, a 6-minute walk from Mas Pastora. Filed per the dinner-plan note as the easy hotel-terrace backup rather than a first booking (its September calendar was unstable during verification — have the concierge confirm).
locations.address: Passeig de Cipsela, 1, 17211 Llafranc, Girona, Spain

references.note: Rank 12: convenient and scenic beachfront terrace; exact Sep 7–9 calendar unstable during research — treat as concierge backup.
Official restaurants page.

locations.name: La Blava
locations.description: Tucked under Calella's traditional stone arches (the voltes) right on the Port Bo sand — widely considered one of the most romantic spots in town for traditional Mediterranean seafood. The candlelit-on-the-beach dinner of this leg. Dinner-plan verdict: rank 1 of the Llafranc-week options — booked-in as the Wednesday Sep 9 romantic dinner (live calendar showed Mon–Wed dinner availability, terrace and indoor). ~€40–70 pp; 24-minute flat walk over in daylight, taxi back after wine; ask for 'una mesa exterior con vistas al mar, si es posible.' Table assignments aren't final until the restaurant confirms.
locations.address: Carrer Miramar, 3, 17210 Calella de Palafrugell, Girona, Spain

references.note: Rank 1 / best overall fit: fisherman's house over Port Bo, Empordà cooking, Chelsea-ideal; live Mon–Wed; best date Wed Sep 9 at 8:00–8:15.
Official reservation calendar.

locations.name: La Llagosta
locations.description: Beachfront seafood-and-rice house on the Llafranc seafront, steps from Mas Pastora — bay views, fresh fish, no booking needed. The default spontaneous lunch of the Costa Brava leg. Dinner-plan intel: the arrival-night pick (Mon Sep 7, 8:30 PM — terrace or the glass sea-view room). Family fishing-house pedigree; Palamós fish, Pals rice, vegetables from their own garden, Empordà wine; ~€50 pp before drinks. ⚠️ CLOSED WEDNESDAYS; live calendar showed Mon and Tue open. Tell them Chelsea doesn't eat red meat or duck when booking.
locations.address: Carrer de Francesc de Blanes, 24, 17211 Llafranc, Girona, Spain

references.note: Rank 2 / best arrival night: 7–8 min flat walk; live Mon & Tue, closed Wed; ~€50 pp; garden vegetables and Empordà wine.
Official restaurant page; reservations via myrestoo.

locations.tags: beachfront, closed-wednesday, monday-pick, rice, seafood, walk-in

locations.name: Casa Juanita
locations.description: Circled-and-hearted on Sea Salt Living's Begur list for its oven-baked fish ('fish in the oven') — an old-school seafood house in Begur town and one of the guide's clearest favorites. Dinner-plan intel: the Tuesday Sep 8 pick, paired with a pre-dinner Begur wander to the castle viewpoint. Running since 1978 in a 17th-century building, still cooking rock fish in the original holm-oak wood oven. ⚠️ Closed Mondays; reservations by LIVE PHONE CALL only (+34 972 62 20 13 — voicemail doesn't count); whole fish is priced by weight, so ask cost before ordering. Chelsea note: skip the Iberian-ham-with-squid starter; the fish, escalivada, anchovies, octopus and cod all fit.
locations.address: Carrer Pi i Ralló, 7, 17255 Begur, Girona, Spain

references.note: Rank 3 / best authentic food + change of scenery: 1978, holm-oak oven, market rock fish; closed Mon; phone-only reservations; ask fish price by weight.
Official history, menu and reservation policy.

locations.tags: begur-town, closed-monday, dinner, oven-baked-fish, phone-only-booking, seafood, tuesday-pick, wood-oven

locations.name: Toc al Mar
locations.description: Beach restaurant directly on the sand at Cala Aiguablava — whole fish and paella over an oak-wood fire, long barefoot-luxury lunches. The most-corroborated restaurant on the Costa Brava list: two Gemini conversations, Matt's guide-adjacent batches, the Sea Salt Living Begur guide, and now the 106K-like 7-day itinerary reel ('delicious paella right on the beach'). Raised to a 5: it's the flagship lunch of the Costa Brava leg, 15 minutes from Mas Pastora. Reservations coveted — book well ahead for early September. Dinner-plan intel for the Llafranc week: first-line heated-terrace dinner slots showed LIVE for all three nights (Sep 7–9, 8:00–9:30 PM) — and a critical menu rule: ⚠️ NO RICE DISHES AT DINNER, so book it for whole wild fish and shellfish over the holm-oak fire (sea bream, sea bass, scorpionfish, Begur lobster, Palamós prawns), not paella. 16-minute taxi each way — prearrange both legs; don't improvise a return from the cove after 10 PM.
locations.address: Carrer Platja d'Aiguablava, 8, 17255 Begur, Girona, Spain

references.note: Rank 5: first-line terrace live all three nights; rice not served at dinner — grilled fish/shellfish only; prebook both taxi legs.
Official reservation calendar with the dinner rice note.

locations.tags: book-asap, chiringuito, heated-terrace, live-calendar, lunch, no-rice-at-dinner, paella, reservation-required, seafood, waterfront, wood-fired

locations.name: Sa Rascassa
locations.description: Romantic pick from Sea Salt Living's Begur guide — the restaurant of tiny Hostal Sa Rascassa, tucked in the pines steps from Cala Aiguafreda. Garden-terrace dinners in one of the quietest corners of the Begur coast. Dinner-plan intel: the most intimate romantic escape of the week — garden courtyard at the Aiguafreda cove, rock fish and rice, 4.4/5 across 500+ TripAdvisor reviews. ⚠️ Closed Tuesday Sep 8 (calendar showed Mon and Wed bookable); it's a deliberate 26-minute drive, so book a driver or prearranged return taxi — no cars wait in the cove.

references.note: Rank 6 / most intimate: Mon & Wed bookable, Tue closed; 26-min drive; prearrange the return.
Official restaurant page.

locations.name: Sol i Mar
locations.description: Classic Calella establishment on Carrer Miramar known for high-quality ingredients at reasonable prices — the crispy squid and the socarrat (caramelized crust) on the paella are legendary among locals. Dinner-plan intel: the straightforward waterfront backup for the Llafranc week — ⚠️ closed Mondays (May–Sep schedule Tue–Sun 11:00–23:00); live calendar showed terrace and sea-view interior dinner slots on Tue Sep 8 and Wed Sep 9.
locations.address: Carrer Miramar, 19, 17210 Calella de Palafrugell, Girona, Spain

references.note: Rank 7 / best easygoing backup: closed Mon; live Tue & Wed with terrace and sea-view interior tables.
Official site and opening schedule.

locations.name: El Balcó de Calella
locations.description: The cliff terrace at Hotel Sant Roc over the Calella bay — double-duty: the premier sunset-cocktail spot in town (Matt's guide) AND a seafood lunch with sea views (the 7-day itinerary reel rates the food itself a favorite). Either way, the golden-hour ritual of a Calella/Llafranc base. Dinner-plan intel: the panoramic-dinner option of the week — first-row balcony, pergola and garden tables above Calella's coves. ⚠️ Closed Tuesday Sep 8; first-row sea-view slots showed live for Mon Sep 7 and Wed Sep 9 — book the 8:00 PM seating to keep the last daylight and request the first row. 31-minute walk with ~50 m of climb: treat it as a short taxi outing.
locations.address: Plaça Atlàntic, 2, 17210 Calella de Palafrugell, Girona, Spain

references.note: Rank 4 / best panoramic view: live Mon & Wed, closed Tue; book 8:00 PM first row; taxi over the climbing walk.
Official reservation calendar.
